networks.name: synthetic_panel
networks.description: Compare two or three versions of a headline, subject line or offer with three synthetic personas, scored in your browser with Semantic Similarity Rating.
sample_queries: Which headline works better: "Track customer requests in one place." or "Turn scattered customer requests into a prioritized product roadmap."?
Compare these email subject lines: "Your roadmap, minus the guesswork" and "3 ways to stop building the wrong features".
Run the panel on the versions I saved on the page.
What conversion rate will this headline get?

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local actions only. Other sites may call this panel's scorer through its action bridge.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
